decisions.reason: As a niche single-product crate with only limited website prominence, it has weaker visible commitment and is easier to cut despite fitting the reusable-packaging strategy.
This multi-model foldable large container line is central to the firm's core offer and was promoted on its own page across two years, which encourages continued commitment.
The stackable plastic crate line closely matches the firm's established reusable logistics business, and sunk development and tooling costs support persistence.
The medium-duty rackable pallet line sits near the core pallet portfolio, so management is likely to interpret any weak results as temporary and keep it.
The spill-retention pallet line had an initially visible launch and likely required meaningful investment, making management inclined to continue despite softer later visibility.
This plastic pallet with load retainers is adjacent to the main pallet range and publicly launched, but its narrower scope and reduced visibility make it somewhat more at risk than the broader lines.
